channel.title: AI GridWatch — Illinois data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Illinois, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Bloomington: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month pause, unanimous; facilities over 5 MW. At least two public hearings required during the moratorium period

item.title: Normal: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Unanimous; runs through Nov 30, 2026. Preemptive — no active data center inquiries at the time

item.title: Aurora: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 180-day moratorium, 10-1. Expired Mar 24, 2026 and replaced by permanent regulations: noise limits (56/46 dB day/evening), water standards, energy efficiency, annual reporting. 10 existing DCs

item.title: Champaign County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data centers >=10,000 sq ft on unincorporated land. Board reversed committee's 9-month recommendation after hearing from dozens of residents. 100+ attendees. Task force created

item.title: Normal: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium through Nov 30, unanimous. Pause while leaders develop regulations

item.title: Lake County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 8-month moratorium proposed; immediate 120-day administrative deferral enacted. First Chicago-area county to pursue a pause. Directed zoning board to hold hearing on code changes

item.title: Illinois (tax incentives): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Governor Pritzker paused Data Center Investment Program for 2 years. Existing incentive agreements honored. Legislature had adjourned without passing the POWER Act (SB4016/HB5513)

item.title: Rockford: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month pause passed 14-0. Does not cover the Edson Road parcel Monarch Energy is pursuing — an existing annexation agreement already permits data centers there
